name: PSZ2 G114.39-60.16 (Webb)
blurb: PSZ2 G114.39-60.16, a galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: psz2g114-webb
story: A rich cluster of galaxies, one of nearly two hundred that a Webb survey studies to watch clusters grow. The survey traces how a cluster builds its central galaxy and how dark matter is spread through it.

claims.text: PSZ2G114.39-60.16 is a galaxy cluster target (rich cluster) of JWST program 5594, Cluster SLICE
The SLICE survey images 182 galaxy clusters
SLICE studies how clusters build their brightest central galaxy and how dark matter is distributed
